title: Fourier coefficients of the odd part
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the odd part $x\mapsto (f(x)-f(-x))/2$ is $\bigl(1-(-1)^{|S|}\bigr)\widehat f(S)/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
